title: FFI Declarations
summary: Foreign Function Interface allows Rust code to call and be called by foreign C functions.
lecture: FFI relies on extern blocks to declare signatures of functions compiled in external C libraries.
Functions in unsafe extern blocks can be marked safe if they have no memory safety preconditions.
Strings passed across FFI must use C-compatible NUL-terminated types like CStr instead of &str.

example.caption: Safe FFI declarations permit calls without unsafe blocks.
